title: JetBrains PHPverse 2026
content:
Join us for on June 9 – a global live streaming event dedicated to modern PHP practices and the future of the language. JetBrains PHPverse 2026

This year's lineup features talks by renowned voices in the PHP community, including Larry Garfield, Fabien Potencier, Nils Adermann, Elizabeth Barron, and more. You can tune in for the whole day or drop in for the talks that interest you most. . See the full program here

📅 📍 – free and open to everyone June 9, 2026Online

In 2025, PHPverse reached over 55,000 developers worldwide — be part of it this year! . Register now
